name: 5-Amino-1MQ
effects: Small molecule NNMT (nicotinamide N-methyltransferase) inhibitor — NOT a peptide; classified as peptide-mimetic
NNMT inhibition raises cellular NAD+ and SAM (S-adenosylmethionine) pools
Promotes fat cell (adipocyte) browning and reduces adipogenesis in rodent models
Weight loss and metabolic improvement in diet-induced obese mice without dietary changes
Orally bioavailable — advantage over injectable peptides
No human clinical trial data; dose protocols entirely extrapolated from murine studies
Safety profile unknown in humans; NNMT plays roles in methylation and cancer biology
Sourced from research-chemical suppliers — purity and sterility not guaranteed; risk of contamination
